summary.headline: Astrological Inceptions and Judgments
summary.text: Catalog of codex 7 entries on astrological inceptions, covering their causes, signs, houses, ruling stars, Moon, benefics, angles, and twelve-manner divisions, followed by judgments on buying, lost things, and runaways. The entries cite folios 155–157 and an edition in Studi italiani di filologia classica VI, pages 26–27.
